name: Mik
description:
About This Game

Waking up after an untold amount of time, you find yourself in the decaying remains of a vast, lifeless facility. Set in a Blame!-esque world, you must navigate the depths of an abandoned megastructure—a seemingly endless structure of ruins and corridors.

Through chained parkour movement, you traverse the crumbling infrastructure, exploring a desolate world long forgotten. But there is no one left to witness it but the massive iron structure. 

  • Explore & traverse the vastness of the Megastructure

  • Find your way through spaces as small as ventilation shafts to giant rooms of which you cant even see the end

  • Uncover the past and piece together the mysterious lore

  • Combine classic parkour with environmental puzzles

  • Jump, Wallrun and Dash through the game...

  • ... or take it slow and enjoy the view
short_desc: Mik is an atmospheric, narrative-driven platformer, set in a post-apocalyptic world. What was once a thriving megastructure is now a rotting corpse of a facility, where you find yourself exploring fragments of the past.
